description: This file defines the ClassSingleSegmentBuffer class, which implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface for managing a byte buffer with methods for writing, resetting, and retrieving data as various memory representations.

classes.name: ClassSingleSegmentBuffer
classes.description: A buffer writer class that manages a single segment byte array, providing methods to write data, retrieve memory, reset, and convert to array or string.

methods.name: ClassSingleSegmentBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a provided byte array.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the buffer starting at the current write position.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the buffer starting at the current write position.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Returns the written portion of the buffer as a byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the write position to zero.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Property that gets the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the written buffer data to a UTF8 string.
